headline: At 64, Nigerian Immigrant Graduates as Nurse While Studying Beside His Son
meta_description: John Adesoye, 64, completed a nursing degree at the University of West England while attending classes one day weekly with his son Daniel.
summary_short: A 64-year-old father of five has graduated from nursing school in Bristol, having studied part-time on campus alongside his son, who pursued a degree in creative music t…
body:
John Adesoye, a 64-year-old Nigerian immigrant and father of five, has achieved what he once thought impossible: earning a nursing degree from the University of West England. After completing both a two-year nurse associate program and a two-year nurse apprenticeship at the National Health Services Foundation Trust in Bristol, Adesoye has secured a nursing role at Southmead Hospital, where he completed his practical training. What makes his achievement remarkable is not just the age at which he pursued higher education, but the circumstance that saw him spend one day each week studying on campus alongside his own son, Daniel, who was earning a degree in creative music technology.

Adesoye's path to nursing reflects a lifetime of curiosity. Growing up in a poor farming family in Nigeria, he developed a keen interest in how things worked—a fascination that began with his family's radio. He later worked as an electronics technician in Greece before settling in the UK. When the opportunity to attend university finally came, he approached it with deliberate intention. "I didn't think I'd ever go to university, to be honest," he reflected. "But I have passion for learning. Even when I was small, I was so curious. When I got the chance to go to university, I didn't take it for granted—I followed it with my heart."

Adesoye's message to others is clear: age need not be a barrier to education. "Don't listen to people who say you're too old for university," he said. "If I can do it, others can too. People are more brilliant than they think and they're stronger than they think." His story joins a growing chorus of voices proving that the capacity to learn transcends age—and that sometimes the best time to pursue a dream is simply when you decide to begin.
quick_facts: 64-year-old Nigerian immigrant graduated from nursing school in Bristol
Studied one day weekly on campus alongside his son Daniel
Now working as a nurse at Southmead Hospital
